rule.name: gotta
rule.message: Consider 'got to' or 'have to' for formal writing.

rule.name: finna
rule.message: Consider 'going to' or 'about to' for formal writing.

rule.name: ain't
rule.message: Consider 'isn't', 'aren't', or 'am not' for formal writing.

rule.name: alot
rule.message: 'Alot' is not a word. Use 'a lot'.

rule.name: awhile/a while
rule.message: 'A while' should be two words after 'for'.

rule.name: double period
rule.message: Use a single period or ellipsis (...).

rule.name: question mark period
rule.message: Remove redundant period after question mark.

rule.name: very unique
rule.message: 'Unique' means one of a kind; it doesn't need 'very'.

rule.name: advance planning
rule.message: Planning is by definition in advance.

rule.name: brief summary
rule.message: A summary is by definition brief.

rule.name: future plans
rule.message: Plans are by definition for the future.

rule.name: affect/effect
rule.message: 'Effect' is usually the noun; 'affect' is the verb.

rule.name: loose/lose
rule.message: 'Lose' means to misplace; 'loose' means not tight.
